card.name: Words inside dictionary-style definitions
card.fires_on: Words inside the opening definition sentence of a general topic, such as cooking, procurement or management. It fires on small linking words and verbs like "in", "to", "by", "is" and "of" within the definition.

modes.label: Cooking definition
modes.description: Words in a definition of cooking as combining ingredients in an ordered procedure.
modes.example: It is the process of selecting, measuring and combining of ingredients<< in>> an ordered procedure in an effort to achieve

modes.label: Other definitions
modes.description: Linking words in a short definition of a term such as procurement or assistive technology.
modes.example: Government procurement refers<< to>> purchases of goods or services, including consult
